newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: BCP hits high on optimism over performance.
newsitem.headline: BCP hits high on optimism over performance.

text.p: Shares in Banco Comercial Portugues surged to a new high of 3,699 escudos on optimism about Portugal's biggest private bank after its six-month results and dealers said the next target was 3,750 escudos.

"The rise of BCP is associated with the good results for the first half, the fact that it is a solid bank and is benefitting from the strong performance of the sector generally, and the stock could hit 3,750 escudos today if conditions remain favourable," a dealer said.
"BCP has not yet managed to surpass 3,700 escudos, but it is inevitable that it will reach that level if the market remains on this upward path," another operator said.
BCP stood at 3,650 escudos, up 107, in turnover of 140,880 at 0946 GMT.
